package sample

import (
    "context"
    "errors"
    "net/http"
    "testing"
)

func request(t *testing.T) *http.Request {
    t.Helper()
    r, err := http.NewRequest("GET", "http://ownership.invalid", nil)
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    return r
}

func TestErrorRelease(t *testing.T) {
    for _, withResponse := range []bool{false, true} {
        var observed context.Context
        var original *http.Response
        if withResponse { original = &http.Response{StatusCode: 503} }
        sentinel := errors.New("transport failure")
        got, err := invoke(request(t), func(ctx context.Context) (*http.Response, error) {
            observed = ctx
            return original, sentinel
        })
        if got != original || err != sentinel { t.Error("original response or transport error lost") }
        if observed == nil { t.Fatal("transport was not called") }
        if observed.Err() != context.Canceled { t.Error("transport error did not release context") }
    }
}

func TestEmptyRelease(t *testing.T) {
    for _, original := range []*http.Response{nil, {StatusCode: 204}} {
        var observed context.Context
        got, err := invoke(request(t), func(ctx context.Context) (*http.Response, error) {
            observed = ctx
            return original, nil
        })
        if got != original || err != nil { t.Error("empty response changed") }
        if observed == nil { t.Fatal("transport was not called") }
        if observed.Err() != context.Canceled { t.Error("empty body did not release context") }
    }
}

type observedBody struct {
    ctx context.Context
    closeErr error
    closes int
    canceledDuringClose bool
}
func (b *observedBody) Read(p []byte) (int, error) {
    if err := b.ctx.Err(); err != nil { return 0, err }
    return copy(p, "payload"), nil
}
func (b *observedBody) Close() error {
    b.closes++
    b.canceledDuringClose = b.ctx.Err() != nil
    return b.closeErr
}

func TestBodyLifetime(t *testing.T) {
    sentinel := errors.New("close failure")
    raw := &observedBody{closeErr: sentinel}
    original := &http.Response{Body: raw}
    got, err := invoke(request(t), func(ctx context.Context) (*http.Response, error) {
        raw.ctx = ctx
        return original, nil
    })
    if err != nil || got != original { t.Fatalf("dispatch changed: %v", err) }
    if raw.ctx.Err() != nil { t.Fatal("body canceled when dispatch returned") }
    p := make([]byte, 16)
    n, err := got.Body.Read(p)
    if err != nil || string(p[:n]) != "payload" { t.Fatalf("body read changed: %v", err) }
    if err := got.Body.Close(); err != sentinel { t.Error("original Close error lost") }
    if raw.closes != 1 || raw.canceledDuringClose { t.Error("underlying Close ordering changed") }
    if raw.ctx.Err() != context.Canceled { t.Error("Close did not release context") }
}

func TestParentCancellation(t *testing.T) {
    parent, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
    defer cancel()
    raw := &observedBody{}
    got, err := invoke(request(t).WithContext(parent), func(ctx context.Context) (*http.Response, error) {
        raw.ctx = ctx
        return &http.Response{Body: raw}, nil
    })
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    cancel()
    if _, err := got.Body.Read(make([]byte, 8)); err != context.Canceled { t.Error("parent cancellation lost during body read") }
    if err := got.Body.Close(); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if raw.closes != 1 { t.Error("body close lost") }
}
